items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.description: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 88% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 9.1.

w5h.what_impacted: Systems running Adobe Commerce and Magento
w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for Adobe Commerce and Magento per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-09-27)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 88% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached.

impact.affected_versions: Adobe Commerce and Magento (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Inventory all Adobe Commerce and Magento installations and compare versions against the advisory. Review logs on matching hosts for unusual authentication or administrative actions.
